description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.foreign_shape parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: shape array or other calls make_finding with the fingerprint omitted. Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits a finding.
Python int is unbounded. Rust checked i64 overflow is PYTHON_INT_UNBOUNDED.
A bool is not an int. first_ordinal is omitted when the ordinal is absent or < 0.
MapLookup::Borrowed is a failed borrow, not a missing key.
The 8-hex provider hash is evidence on a firing record only. sha256 of the stripped string openai is 7d3194f7. Do not put a firing case in the required vectors.
